name: Slow Cooker Chipotle Pulled Pork
evidence: Clears all conditions (428 cal / 3g carb per serving, zero seafood, whole pork shoulder scales cleanly to 14). Not a strict duplicate of any single catalog dish: the nearest chipotle+pork-shoulder entry is 'mexican-chipotle-pork-and-beans' (chipotle-adobo + pork-shoulder + orange-juice) but that is a saucy pork-AND-BEANS braise, and 'slow-cooker-pork-tinga-bowls' is a tomato-based tinga over rice - this candidate is a DRY shredded chipotle-rub pulled pork (no beans, no tomato, no starch, served in lettuce/cauli), so protein+flavor match but starch+plate-format differ (2 of 4).

catalog_nearest.why_not_dupe: saucy pork+beans stew with orange juice; candidate is dry pulled pork, no beans
tomato-forward tinga over rice; candidate has no tomato and no rice
chile birria stew with broth/salsa/tortillas; candidate is a dry rub pulled pork

pool_note: No other chipotle pulled pork shoulder in this run's pool. Nearest pool pork-shoulders are differently flavored: coffee-rubbed-slow-cooker-pork-shoulder (coffee), crispy-pork-carnitas (citrus), pork-chile-verde-stew (tomatillo-verde), korean/momofuku bossam - none collide.
cross_protein_collision_flags: chicken-tinga-shredded-chipotle (THIS run, chicken lane) and catalog slow-cooker-chicken-tinga-bowls / chipotle-turkey-burrito are the structural chipotle-shredded twins in other proteins - decider should confirm this dry chipotle pulled pork is not merely the pork cast of a shredded-chipotle dish already selected in another protein.
A 'chipotle shredded chicken' or 'chipotle turkey' dry version would be the same dinner with the protein swapped - flag for cross-protein merge.
borderline_reason: Chipotle content is minimal (1/2 Tbsp adobo across a 10-serving batch) so the plate reads as a near-plain slow-cooker pulled pork, and the catalog is already heavily saturated with slow-cooker/Mexican-Tex-Mex pork; it widens cuisine spread only marginally. Distinct enough to KEEP, but audit should weigh it against catalog saturation.
unmapped_note: coconut-sugar is a genuine board gap (tiny, 1 Tbsp/batch); smoked-paprika maps to board 'paprika'. Per v2.1 5.1 not penalized - wanted for pricer lane exercise.
